title: Research: prove sharp six source-XOR floor at seven queries (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

In the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898), every restored straight-line word with **exactly seven queries** needs **at least six source XORs**. The bound is sharp: the path-lowered champion `(0,1,2,6,12,24,16,0)` attains `7 Q / 82 R / 6 X` (abstract tariff **442** at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`).

| X length | Min interaction components | Query floor `5+c` | Admits `Q=7`? |
|---:|---:|---:|---|
| ≤2 | ≥4 | ≥9 | no |
| 4 or 5 | 3 | 8 | no |
| **6** | **2** | **7** | **yes (sharp)** |

This closes the non-path XOR floor left open by the path-lowered `mutable-source-789q-invoice` OQ1: already `X≤5` is impossible at `Q=7`, so `X≤2` with `R=82` is impossible. Graph digests for lengths 0–6 match open [#2455](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2455)'s published census (that PR proves `X≥8` at **six** queries).

**Scoped obstruction with sharp attainment; no new kappa.** No claim that seven-query words cannot undercut tariff 436 by lowering `R` while keeping `X≥6`. Leave-alone through [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593) and pending `mutable-source-789q-invoice` were not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/seven-query-xor-floor/`.
Tip: `14fd0c3177b51f8d17e6fa8ba7ed3ee81989285a`.

Exact: `Q=7` forces `min_X=6`; `X≤5` blocked; champion attains sharpness.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-query-xor-floor/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/seven-query-xor-floor/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-query-xor-floor/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-query-xor-floor/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/seven-query-xor-floor
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SEVEN_QUERY_XOR_FLOOR Q=7 min_X=6 sharp X<=5 blocked answers_789q_oq1 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_SEVEN_QUERY_XOR_FLOOR min_X=6 floors_block_X_le_5 ... tariff=442 controls=2
PASS_SEVEN_QUERY_XOR_FLOOR_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/seven-query-xor-floor outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#2455](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2455) (`X≥8` at Q=6), [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898), path-lowered 789q invoice (OQ1). Freestanding package; no competing open PR on this claim at refresh.
